map.对文本行按字母、数字或长度排序，支持升序降序与去重，便于整理名单、参数表与日志条: Sorts text lines alphabetically, numerically, or by length, with ascending/descending order and deduplication support. Great for tidying name lists, parameter tables, and log entries; results are copyable and computed entirely in your browser.
map.名单与字典序：把无序列表按拼音/字母升序排，便于查阅。: Names and lexicographic order: sort an unordered list by pinyin or alphabetically in ascending order for easier lookup.
map.数据预处理：排序后便于去重与比对差异。: Data preprocessing: sorting first makes deduplication and diffing easier.
map.展示规整：把标签/关键词排成稳定顺序。: Tidy presentation: put tags and keywords into a stable order.
map.中文名单拼音排序: Sort a Chinese Name List by Pinyin
map.：输入「张三/李四/王五」，按拼音升序得「李四/王五/张三」（L/W/Z），输出: : enter "Zhang San/Li Si/Wang Wu" and sorting by pinyin gives "Li Si/Wang Wu/Zhang San" (L/W/Z), a stable, readable order; Chinese is sorted by pinyin rather than stroke count, which better matches search habits.
map.默认按字符（「10」会排在「2」前）；需按数值大小排请用「自然排序/高级排序」，: By default it sorts by character, so "10" comes before "2"; to sort by numeric value use natural sort or advanced sorting, which places 10 after 2.
map.升序降序都可？: Are Both Ascending and Descending Supported?
map.可。降序即反转结果；中英文混排建议先统一或选对应排序规则。: Yes. Descending is just the reversed result; for mixed Chinese and English, normalize first or pick the matching sort rule.
